dimensions.summary: Projections, slices and workspace composition preserve one canonical generation without parallel truth.
Projection, slice, derived analytics and dual-scope orchestration each declare independent bounded budgets.
Workspace composition reuses immutable project generations and local query/worker budgets remain within declared ceilings.
Project and workspace publication remain locked, pointer-last and schema-bound with separate writer locks per scope.
Derived projections and dual-scope results carry explicit limitations, omissions and portable relative references.
Local checks pass; retained same-commit Linux, macOS and Windows G5 evidence remains required.
Standalone orchestration, derived projections and dual-scope inspect operate without central CLI runtime imports.
Projection, slice, derived analytics and workspace composition fixtures preserve canonical identity and stable ordering.
Projection, slice and derived projection wire contracts are versioned candidates in the content-addressed catalog.
Dual-scope failures preserve valid project generations and report handoff-unavailable or partial workspace status honestly.
G5 checkpoints have dedicated application, projection, adapter and CLI coverage with governance evidence paths.
The package remains private and packed output excludes source, tests, governance, scripts, maps and internal documents.

checks.evidence: Package-owned build, contract, test, runtime, packed-consumer and admission gates pass locally.
All G5 stage-plan checkpoints except g5-cross-platform-admission are implemented-local-candidate.
Same-commit Linux, macOS and Windows G5 admission evidence is not yet retained.

remainingRisks: The signed candidate still requires retained Linux, Windows and macOS G5 evidence.
Central CLI onboarding remains an optional handoff; default standalone mode stays honest and partial without it.
Contract-topology, architecture-conformance and richer derived intelligence profiles remain later G5/G6 work.
Rust, native and WASM acceleration remain prohibited until G6 measurements justify a parity-checked adapter.
Central CLI shadow parity and replacement remain prohibited until G8.

approval.rule: A signed checkpoint plus retained same-commit Linux, Windows and macOS G5 evidence authorizes G6 only.
